blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY— Eleven passengers of a jeepney were injured after the vehicle overturned along the national road in Sitio Bagacuta, Barangay Paroyhog, Santa Maria town in Romblon on Wednesday. All those injured were promptly brought to a hospital for medical attention, according to a report from the Santa Maria Municipal Police Station (MPS).
